hook.name: IronHook2
hook.description: Takes a tiered ETH tithe (60–100 bps, graduated by cumulative ETH banked) from every swap via BeforeSwapDelta and AfterSwapDelta, accumulating proceeds per-pool. Once the pot exceeds 0.02 ETH, anyone can call bank() to distribute it 60/15/15/10 across a floor vault, launch creator, FolioBurner, and protocol treasury, with a 1% bounty to the caller.
